description: This file represents the main component for the Tic Tac Toe game frontend. It manages game state, handles user interactions, and renders the game board and status.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Checks the board for a winning combination and returns the winner ('X' or 'O') or null if there is none.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Determines if the game is a draw based on the current state of the board.

methods.name: handleCellClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on the game board cells, updates the board, and checks for a winner.

methods.name: computerMove
methods.description: Simulates a move by the computer in the game if the selected game mode is 'computer'.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to the initial state.

methods.name: handleModeSelect
methods.description: Handles the selection of game mode (computer or player) and resets the game accordingly.
